 Order

This petition under Section 482 of Cr.P.C. is filed by the petitioners challenging the proceedings in C.C.No.1516/2019 on the file of the III Additional JMFC Court at Kalaburagi, for the offences punishable under Sections 498A, 323, 307, 504 and 506 read with Section 34 of IPC.
02.

entities.text: III Additional JMFC Court at Kalaburagi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The case of the prosecution is that, the de-facto complainant is the legally wedded wife of accused No.1, and the other accused are the relatives of the husband and they have subjected the de-facto - complainant to cruelty, both mentally and physically, and also demanded to bring money from the parental home.
03. The learned Magistrate has taken cognizance for the aforesaid offences.
Taking exception of the same, the accused are before this Court.

The parties are present before this Court and they have filed an application in I.A.No.1/2023 for compounding of the offences and also a Joint Memo stating at the instance of elderly persons, the parties have amicably settled the dispute among themselves and the respondent No.2 - de-facto complainant has gone back to the matrimonial home and leading cordial marital life.
The respondent No.2 - de-facto complainant has no objection for quashing the impugned proceedings.

05. Though, the offences alleged are cognizable, it would be a futile exercise, if the accused are subjected to the trial, since the probability of their conviction is remote and bleak, in view of the settlement arrived between the parties.
Hence, the continuation of criminal proceedings will be an abuse of process of law.

Hence, I pass the following;
ORDER I.
The Criminal Petition is allowed.

The impugned proceedings in  C.C.No.1516/2019 on the file of the III  Additional JMFC, at Kalaburagi, is hereby Promod @ Pintu And Ors vs The State And Anr on 21 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/162064999/
3  quashed.
